title: Rav Binah
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.
copyright: English translation and editorial notes © 2026 Joshua Waxman. All rights reserved.
paragraphs: He is mentioned at the beginning of Jerusalem Talmud Bava Metzia, chapter 6: “Rabbi Zeira in the name of Rav Huna; Rav Binah, Rabbi Yirmeyah (bar Abba) in the name of Rav.” Seder HaDorot cites Rabbi Chizkiyah in the name of Rav Bini from Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 3:3; Hyman says an erroneous Jerusalem Talmud text came his way and proposes “Rabbi Chizkiyah in the name of Rav: kini, he saw them,” which is like “here we are dealing with” in the Babylonian Talmud.

notes.text: The citation is Jerusalem Talmud Bava Metzia chapter 6. Saved Guggenheimer 6:1 fully writes Rabbi Binah, while Hyman’s supplied full form is Rav Binah; both forms remain disclosed. Zeira/Huna context supports the connected expansion without harmonizing the witnesses.
